name: Trumpet Studio: Learn & Play
summary:
Sit in a cozy music studio and bring a golden trumpet to your face. Real trumpet recordings answer every note.

When a lesson starts, the curtain dissolves into light and a neon stage opens up. Notes fly out of a brass bell as glowing cubes: play the right note on the beat and your blade cuts them. A live staff shows the note to play and the note you played.

• 75 lessons in five paths: fundamentals, songs, technique, scales and improvisation
